s0003.literal: The Last Emperor, taboo name Shubao, style Yuanxiu, childhood name Huangnu, was the legitimate eldest son of Emperor Xuan.
s0003.idiomatic: The Last Emperor, whose personal name was tabooed as Shubao, who styled himself Yuanxiu and in youth was called Huangnu, was the legitimate eldest son of Emperor Xuan.

s0004.literal: In the eleventh month, wuyin day, of the second year of Liang's Chengsheng era, he was born at Jiangling.
s0004.idiomatic: He was born on wuyin day in the eleventh month of Liang's Chengsheng year 2 (553) at Jiangling.

s0005.literal: The next year Jiangling fell; Emperor Xuan was moved to the Guan region, and the Last Emperor was left at Rang city.
s0005.idiomatic: The next year Jiangling fell; Emperor Xuan was taken west to the Guan region, and the Last Emperor was left at Rang.

s0006.literal: In the third year of Tianjia he returned to the capital and was established as heir of the Prince of Ancheng.
s0006.idiomatic: In Tianjia year 3 (564) he returned to the capital and was made heir of the Prince of Ancheng.

s0007.literal: In the first year of Tiankang he was appointed General of Far Pacification, with aides and clerks.
s0007.idiomatic: In Tiankang year 1 (566) he was made general of far pacification, with aides and clerks.

s0008.literal: In the second year of Guangda he became junior mentor of the heir apparent; soon he was transferred to palace attendant, the rest as before.
s0008.idiomatic: In Guangda year 2 (567) he became junior mentor of the heir apparent, then palace attendant, other offices unchanged.

s0009.literal: In the first month, jiawu day, of the first year of Taijian, he was established as crown prince.
s0009.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the first month of Taijian year 1 (569) he was made crown prince.

s0010.literal: In the first month, jiayin day, of the fourteenth year, Emperor Xuan died.
s0010.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the first month of year 14, Emperor Xuan died.

s0011.literal: On yimao day the Prince of Shixing Shuling rebelled and was executed.
s0011.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince Shuling of Shixing rebelled and was put to death.

s0012.literal: On dingsi day the crown prince took the throne as emperor in the hall before the Supreme Ultimate.
s0012.idiomatic: On dingsi day the crown prince ascended the throne in the hall before the Supreme Ultimate.

s0013.literal: An edict said: "Heaven has sent down calamity; the late emperor has abruptly abandoned the myriad realms. We wail and beat our breasts, unable to reach him.
s0013.idiomatic: An edict said: "Heaven has sent down calamity; the late emperor has suddenly left the realm. We wail and beat our breasts, unable to reach him.

s0014.literal: We, orphaned and alone, have succeeded to the precious succession; it is as if crossing a great river, not knowing how to cross—We must rely on you lords to shore up Our feebleness.
s0014.idiomatic: We, orphaned and alone, have taken the throne; it is like crossing a great river without knowing the ford—we must rely on you lords to steady Our weakness.

s0015.literal: We think to spread his surviving virtue and extend it to the hundred millions; all near and far alike shall share in renewal.
s0015.idiomatic: We mean to spread his surviving virtue to the hundred millions; near and far alike shall share in renewal.

s0016.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0016.idiomatic: A general amnesty is proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0017.literal: Civil and military officials in office, and filial sons, dutiful brothers, and strong farmers who are heirs to their fathers, are each granted one step of nobility.
s0017.idiomatic: Civil and military officials in post, and the filial, the dutiful, strong farmers, and heirs, each receive one step of nobility.

s0018.literal: The solitary old, widowers, and widows who cannot support themselves are each given five hu of grain and two bolts of silk.
s0018.idiomatic: The solitary old, widowers, and widows who cannot support themselves receive five hu of grain and two bolts of silk each.

s0019.literal: " On guihai day the palace attendant, aide-before-the-throne general, and Administrator of Danyang, Prince of Changsha Shujian, was made general of agile cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of Yangzhou; Right Guard General Xiao Mohe was made general of chariots and cavalry and Inspector of South Xuzhou, Editorial footnote marker 1. Garrison West General and Inspector of Jingzhou Fan Yi was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns West; Pacify South General and Inspector of Yuzhou Ren Zhong was advanced in title to General Who Garrisons South, Editorial footnote marker 2. Protector General Shen Ke was made special grand master and grand master for the imperial insignia; Pacify West General Lu Guangda was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies West; Benevolent Martial General and Inspector of Fengzhou Zhang Dabao was made protector general.
s0019.idiomatic: On guihai day Shujian, Prince of Changsha, palace attendant, aide-before-the-throne general, and administrator of Danyang, was made general of agile cavalry with a mansion equal to the three dukes and inspector of Yangzhou; Xiao Mohe, right guard general, was made general of chariots and cavalry and inspector of South Xuzhou [1]; Fan Yi, garrison west general and inspector of Jingzhou, was promoted to general who campaigns west; Ren Zhong, pacify south general and inspector of Yuzhou, to general who garrisons south [2]; Shen Ke, protector general, to special grand master with the golden seal and purple ribbon; Lu Guangda, pacify west general, to general who pacifies west; Zhang Dabao, benevolent martial general and inspector of Fengzhou, to protector general.

s0020.literal: On yichou day the empress was honored as empress dowager; her palace was named Broad Pattern.
s0020.idiomatic: On yichou day the empress was honored as empress dowager, her palace named Broad Pattern.

s0021.literal: On gengyin day the Champion General, Prince of Jinxi Shuwu, was made Manifest Grace General and Administrator of Danyang.
s0021.idiomatic: On gengyin day Shuwu, Prince of Jinxi, champion general, was made manifest grace general and administrator of Danyang.

s0022.literal: On dingmao day the younger brother Shuzhong was established as Prince of Shixing, Editorial footnote marker 3. to maintain the sacrifices of Prince Zhao-lie.
s0022.idiomatic: On dingmao day the younger brother Shuzhong was made Prince of Shixing [3] to tend Prince Zhao-lie's shrine.

s0023.literal: On jisi day Consort Shen was established as empress.
s0023.idiomatic: On jisi day Lady Shen was made empress.

s0024.literal: On xinwei day the imperial younger brother Shuyan was established as Prince of Xunyang; the imperial younger brother Shushen as Prince of Yueyang, Editorial footnote marker 4. the imperial younger brother Shuda as Prince of Yiyang; the imperial younger brother Shuxiong as Prince of Bashan, Editorial footnote marker 5. the imperial younger brother Shuyu as Prince of Wuchang.
s0024.idiomatic: On xinwei day the imperial brother Shuyan was made Prince of Xunyang; Shushen Prince of Yueyang [4]; Shuda Prince of Yiyang; Shuxiong Prince of Bashan [5]; Shuyu Prince of Wuchang.

s0025.literal: On renshen day the palace attendant, central authority general, and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Poyang Boshan, was advanced in title to Grand General of Central Authority; Military Adviser General and Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Jin'an Bogong, was advanced in title to Aide-before-the-Throne General and palace attendant; Aide-right General and Central Army Commander, Prince of Luling Boren, was advanced in title to General Who Secures the Van, Editorial footnote marker 6. Garrison South General and Inspector of Jiangzhou, Prince of Yuzhang Shuying, was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns South; Pacify South General and Inspector of Xiangzhou, Prince of Jian'an Shuqing, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies South.
s0025.idiomatic: On renshen day Boshan, Prince of Poyang, palace attendant, central authority general, and opener equal to the three dukes, was promoted to grand general of central authority; Bogong, Prince of Jin'an, military adviser general and left vice minister, to aide-before-the-throne general and palace attendant; Boren, Prince of Luling, aide-right general and central army commander, to general who secures the van [6]; Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang, garrison south general and Jiangzhou inspector, to general who campaigns south; Shuqing, Prince of Jian'an, pacify south general and Xiangzhou inspector, to general who pacifies south.

s0026.literal: The palace attendant, Secretariat Supervisor, and Secure-the-Right General Xu Ling was made Left Grand Master of the Glory and concurrently Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
s0026.idiomatic: Xu Ling, palace attendant, secretariat supervisor, and secure-the-right general, was made left grand master of the glory and junior tutor of the heir apparent.

s0027.literal: On jiaxu day a Boundless Assembly was held in the hall before the Supreme Ultimate.
s0027.idiomatic: On jiaxu day a Boundless Assembly was held in the hall before the Supreme Ultimate.

s0028.literal: In the third month, xinhai day, an edict said: "Taking the plow as encouragement—its meaning shines in the former classics; rewarding strength in farming—its matter is proclaimed in past edicts.
s0028.idiomatic: In the third month on xinhai day an edict said: "To take the plow as encouragement is plain in the classics; to reward strong farming was proclaimed in old edicts.

s0029.literal: These are what nourish the state's granaries and bind the people's lives; whether harvest is rich or lean, high or low, none is without them.
s0029.idiomatic: These nourish the state's granaries and bind the people's lives; whether the year is rich or lean, none can do without them.

s0030.literal: Land tax is ancient; delivering straw is of old. Fertile fields are prized at ten gold; stony ground may require three rotations—rich and poor soil differ, and full measure and shortfall are not the same.
s0030.idiomatic: Land tax is ancient and delivering straw is old; fertile fields are worth ten gold, stony ground three rotations—soil differs and levies differ.

s0031.literal: Fraud rises day by day; registers change year by year.
s0031.idiomatic: Fraud rises daily; registers change yearly.

s0032.literal: The Paddy-Field Commissioner is recorded from Western Han; harsh penalties for false returns are heard of in Eastern Han.
s0032.idiomatic: The paddy-field commissioner dates to Western Han; harsh penalties for false returns are known from Eastern Han.

s0033.literal: Old farmers fear the summons; vulgar clerks therefore mock the documents.
s0033.idiomatic: Old farmers dread the summons; petty clerks mock the documents.

s0034.literal: They leave the plow in bands; idlers gather in companies—long to speak of this harm to the silkworm season is cause for deep sighing.
s0034.idiomatic: They leave the plow in bands and idle in companies—to speak of this harm to the silkworm season is cause for deep sighing.

s0035.literal: Now the yang principle is in season and sweet rain moistens the land; spring harrowing should be spread to await the autumn mound.
s0035.idiomatic: Now spring is in season and sweet rain moistens the land; spring harrowing should spread to await the autumn harvest.

s0036.literal: Those who newly open furrows and advance reclamation into overgrown wilds—however broad, no measure shall be taken; levies and rents are all stopped and remitted.
s0036.idiomatic: Whoever newly opens furrows or advances reclamation into wild land—however broad—shall pay no measure; levies and rents are all remitted.

s0037.literal: Private fields long abandoned may all be claimed and worked; public fields left wild may likewise be freely tilled.
s0037.idiomatic: Private fields long abandoned may be claimed and worked; public fields left wild may be freely tilled.

s0038.literal: If a good magistrate teaches plowing and the plain people bring wine, such oversight and exhortation shall be discussed for reward and promotion.
s0038.idiomatic: If a good magistrate teaches plowing and plain people bring wine, such oversight shall be rewarded and promoted.

s0039.literal: Without, regulations may be drawn up and promulgated to declare Our intent."
s0039.idiomatic: Let regulations be drawn up and promulgated without to declare Our intent."

s0040.literal: " On guihai day an edict said: "To embody the state and order the wilds, to long govern and nurture the people—though institutions may differ in change and tension in loosening or tightening, as to broadly seeking the worthy and reaching even to the humble, using them to harmonize the stew and raise the great hall—sage and middling rulers alike have used this art.
s0040.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict said: "To embody the state and order the wilds, to long govern the people—though institutions differ, all sage and middling rulers have sought the worthy, even the humble, to harmonize the stew and raise the great hall.

s0041.literal: We, of meager worth, have succeeded to the bright throne; though mourning weighs on Our person and thoughts are confused, the altars' burden is heavy and the people's tasks many—We cannot rest in silent ease and dare forget to bring peace; We think how to raise outstanding men and complete the full array.
s0041.idiomatic: We, slight in merit, have taken the bright throne; though mourning weighs on Us and thoughts tangle, the altars are heavy and the people's tasks many—we cannot sit in silent ease and dare forget to bring peace; We mean to raise outstanding men and fill every post.

s0042.literal: Yet in vain We toil at night-dreams and repeatedly press the historiographers and diviners; five visits do not come,
s0042.idiomatic: Yet in vain We toil at night-dreams and press historiographers and diviners; five visits do not come,

s0047.literal: [shen] from dawn We fix Our thought, Editorial footnote marker 8. by day and night We lessen Our care.
s0047.idiomatic: [shen] from dawn We fix Our thought [8], by day and night We lessen Our rest.

s0048.literal: Editorial footnote marker 9. Is it because jade must be eaten and cassia burned that there is no way to advance?
s0048.idiomatic: [9] Is it because one must eat jade and burn cassia that there is no way to advance?

s0049.literal: Will all cherish their talent and lose their state, each thinking only to perfect himself alone?
s0049.idiomatic: Will all hide talent and lose their state, each seeking only private perfection?

s0050.literal: All officials within and without of the nine ranks and above may each recommend one man, to meet the purpose of gathering the eminent.
s0050.idiomatic: All officials within and without of the nine ranks and above may each recommend one man, to meet the purpose of gathering the eminent.

s0051.literal: Moreover, to take the full is difficult and to raise the long may be easy; for great and small employments, clearly state what is to be applied—do not be like the Southern Dipper or the Northern Dipper, named but not real.
s0051.idiomatic: To take the full is hard and to raise the long may be easy; for great and small posts, say clearly what is offered—do not be like the Southern or Northern Dipper, named but not real.

s0052.literal: Those who bear ability and rely on spirit, pressed down in their time, who compose guest plays to pity themselves or draft guest jibes to comfort their will—life is once, and meeting opportunity is truly hard; they too should leave this deep valley and soar on the heavenly road, hurry to the bronze camel to view the state, gaze on the golden horse and come to court; then let them follow that square or round and be trimmed to the compass and rule.
s0052.idiomatic: Those who bear talent and pride, pressed down in their time, who write plays to pity themselves or jibes to comfort their will—life comes once and chance is rare; let them leave this ravine, soar on the heavenly road, hurry to the bronze camel to view the state, gaze on the golden horse and come to court, and be trimmed to the compass and rule.

s0053.literal: " Again an edict said: "Of old the wise queen governed the people and the philosopher-king held the realm; though virtue was called vast and brightness could shine everywhere, still they bent themselves to beg words and lowered their feeling to seek the Way, high consulting the mountain shepherds and low listening to the carriage platforms—thus government was like a spirit and affairs without regret.
s0053.idiomatic: " Another edict said: "Of old the wise queen governed the people and the philosopher-king held the realm; though virtue was vast and light shone everywhere, still they bent to beg words and lowered themselves to seek the Way, consulting mountain shepherds above and carriage men below—thus government was spirit-like and affairs without regret.

s0054.literal: We have inherited the great thread and think to raise the great enterprise, ever fearing the ninefold barrier is already deep and the four hearings not yet broad; We wish to hear flourishing words and not weary Our afflicted feet; if We meet court remonstrance, We do not fear the scales torn.
s0054.idiomatic: We have inherited the great thread and mean to raise the great enterprise, ever fearing the inner court is deep and the four hearings not broad; We wish to hear flourishing words and not weary Our feet; if We meet court remonstrance, We do not fear torn scales.

s0055.literal: Yet soft-mouthed words are perhaps heard among those in office, and belly-slander's meaning may hide among the full ranks—this is not the way to extend reason to utmost fairness and harmonize the emperor's record.
s0055.idiomatic: Yet soft words are perhaps heard in office, and belly-slander may hide among the full ranks—this is not how to extend utmost fairness and harmonize the imperial record.

s0056.literal: Ministers civil and military and all offices within and without—if any have wisdom encompassing government arts and a heart trained in governing forms, who can save the people's hardship in custom or distinguish the sparse and dense in forbidden nets—let each advance loyal counsel without hiding.
s0056.idiomatic: Ministers civil and military and all offices within and without—if any have wisdom in government and a heart trained in rule, who can ease the people's hardship or distinguish what is forbidden—let each advance loyal counsel without hiding.

s0057.literal: We will empty Ourselves to listen and receive, choose the good and act; perhaps deeply to mirror things' feelings and correct Our royal measure.
s0057.idiomatic: We will empty Ourselves to listen, choose the good and act, and deeply mirror the people's feeling to correct Our royal measure.

s0058.literal: " On jisi day the palace attendant, Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing, and newly appointed Aide-before-the-Throne General, Prince of Jin'an Bogong, was made General Who Pacifies South and Inspector of Xiangzhou; the newly appointed Aide-left General, Prince of Yongyang Bozhi, was made Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing; Protector General Zhang Dabao was made Inspector of Fengzhou.
s0058.idiomatic: On jisi day Bogong, Prince of Jin'an, palace attendant, left vice minister, and newly aide-before-the-throne general, was made general who pacifies south and Xiangzhou inspector; Bozhi, Prince of Yongyang, newly aide-left general, was made vice minister; Zhang Dabao, protector general, was made Fengzhou inspector.

s0059.literal: In the fourth month of summer, gengshen day, the prince Yongkang Gong Yin was established as crown prince; those throughout the realm who are heirs to their fathers are granted one step of nobility; kings, dukes, and below are bestowed silk each according to rank.
s0059.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on gengshen day Prince Yin of Yongkang was made crown prince; heirs throughout the realm received one step of nobility; kings, dukes, and below received silk by rank.

s0060.literal: On gengzi day an edict said: "We face the realm and nurture the black-haired people; We mean to bring peace to the thin and shallow and cut redundant expense; extravagance and excess against the center should truly be stopped and cut off.
s0060.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict said: "We face the realm and nurture the people; We mean to bring peace to the thin age and cut waste; extravagance against the center should be stopped.

s0061.literal: Gilded gold and silver foil and such things as clay-and-wood men of painted flowers, and cloth and silk of short width and light weave—all injure wealth and waste industry and especially become plagues.
s0061.idiomatic: Gilded gold and silver foil, clay-and-wood figures, painted flowers, and cloth of short width and light weave—all waste wealth and industry and breed plague.

s0062.literal: Moreover monks and Taoist priests who embrace heterodox left ways and do not follow the canon, and among the people licentious sacrifices, demon books, and all strange marvels—let detailed regulations be drawn up and all forbidden and ended.
s0062.idiomatic: Monks and Taoist priests who embrace heterodox ways and ignore the canon, and among the people licentious rites, demon books, and strange marvels—let detailed rules forbid them all.

s0063.literal: " On guimao day an edict said: "In mid-years We settled Huai and Si and crossed into Qing and Xu; the chieftains of that land all sent full sincerity, sending kin in division to serve as hostages.
s0063.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict said: "In mid-years We settled Huai and Si and crossed into Qing and Xu; the chieftains there sent full sincerity and kin as hostages.

s0064.literal: Now the old land is lost and again becomes another realm; north and south are blocked far and cannot meet; thinking of their separation, We have special affection.
s0064.idiomatic: Now that land is lost and again another realm; north and south are blocked and cannot meet; thinking of their separation, We have special affection.

s0065.literal: Barbarian and Chinese—Our people—the matter is one; why alone forbid and make them part?
s0065.idiomatic: Barbarian and Chinese are alike Our people; why alone forbid and part them?

s0066.literal: Without, let the Office of Hostage Sons and the Eastern Office and those bearing guarded hostages outside all be given clothing and grain, wine and food distributed, and their homeward road followed; where the road is blocked far, then dispatch ships and guards to escort, and they must be made to arrive in safety.
s0066.idiomatic: Let the Office of Hostage Sons and the Eastern Office and guarded hostages abroad receive clothing and grain, wine and food, and the homeward road; where the road is far, dispatch ships and guards so they arrive safe.

s0067.literal: If any have already entered office or for other reasons of duty do not wish to go, it is likewise as they wish."
s0067.idiomatic: If any have already entered office or for other duty do not wish to go, it is likewise as they wish."

s0068.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, guiyou, Bright Prestige General and Regular Attendant of the Direct Communication Bureau Sun Yan was made protector general.
s0068.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, guiyou, Sun Yan, bright prestige general and regular attendant of the direct communication bureau, was made protector general.

s0069.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, xinwei day, a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0069.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn on xinwei day a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0070.literal: That month the river water's color was red like blood, from the capital to Jingzhou.
s0070.idiomatic: That month the river ran red as blood from the capital to Jingzhou.

s0071.literal: On the night of guiwei day in the eighth month heaven had a sound like wind and water striking together.
s0071.idiomatic: On the night of guiwei in the eighth month heaven sounded like wind and water striking together.

s0072.literal: On the night of yiyou day it was again so.
s0072.idiomatic: On the night of yiyou it was again so.

s0073.literal: On gengxu day the bearer of credentials, Area Commander over the armies along the river, and Pacify West General Lu Guangda was made Secure-the-Left General.
s0073.idiomatic: On gengxu day Lu Guangda, credential bearer, area commander along the river, and pacify west general, was made secure-the-left general.

s0074.literal: In the ninth month, wuwu day, a Boundless Assembly was held in the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate; the body was renounced and the imperial carriage's robes surrendered; a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0074.idiomatic: In the ninth month on wuwu day a Boundless Assembly was held in the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate; the emperor renounced his body and imperial robes; a great amnesty was proclaimed.

s0075.literal: On the night of xinhai day heaven in the northeast had a sound like insects flying, gradually moving to the northwest.
s0075.idiomatic: On the night of xinhai heaven in the northeast sounded like insects flying, gradually moving northwest.

s0076.literal: On yimao day the Great White star was seen in daylight.
s0076.idiomatic: On yimao day the Great White was seen in daylight.

s0077.literal: On gengyin day the General of Agile Cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Changsha Shujian, was made Minister of Works; the General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, Prince of Yuzhang Shuying, received his former title and was made opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes.
s0077.idiomatic: On gengyin day Shujian, Prince of Changsha, general of agile cavalry, opener equal to the three dukes, and Yangzhou inspector, was made minister of works; Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang, general who campaigns south and Jiangzhou inspector, received his former title and a mansion equal to the three dukes.

s0078.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Zhide, renyin day, an edict said: "We, of meager worth, have succeeded to guard the great foundation; orphaned and trembling, illness winds about Us; in training custom We have little method, in facing those below no reckoning; Our dread is like treading ice, Our fear like driving rotten wood.
s0078.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of Zhide year 1 on renyin day an edict said: "We, slight in merit, guard the great foundation; orphaned and trembling, illness winds about Us; We have little method in custom and no reckoning below; Our dread is treading ice, Our fear driving rotten wood.

s0079.literal: Yet the four seasons easily flow and the three luminaries swiftly arrive; tassels and ribbons line the steps and jade and silk fill the court; the objects are not new yet the seasons seem old; gazing on former virtue, We ever think of past hours; facing the hall door Our heart chokes, looking at the throne mat Our breath falters.
s0079.idiomatic: Yet the four seasons flow and the three luminaries come; tassels line the steps and jade fills the court; things are not new yet seasons seem old; gazing on former virtue We think of past hours; facing the hall Our heart chokes, at the throne mat Our breath falters.

s0080.literal: We think how to look up and follow the surviving structure, bend down and encourage Our slight person, mold and cast the nine streams, rest the hundred surnames, using broad simplicity to harmonize with yang harmony.
s0080.idiomatic: We mean to follow the surviving design, encourage Our slight person, mold the nine streams, rest the hundred surnames, and use broad simplicity to harmonize with spring.

s0081.literal: A great amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm; Taijian year fifteen is changed to Zhide year one.
s0081.idiomatic: A great amnesty is proclaimed; Taijian year 15 is renamed Zhide year 1.

s0082.literal: The General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, newly appointed opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Yuzhang Shuying, was made Grand General of the Central Guard; the General of Agile Cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Changsha Shujian, was made Inspector of Jiangzhou; the General Who Campaigns East, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of East Yangzhou, Sima Xiaonan, was advanced in title to General of Chariots and Cavalry; the Manifest Grace General and Administrator of Danyang, Prince of Jinxi Shuwu, was made Inspector of Yangzhou; the General Who Garrisons South and Inspector of South Yuzhou Ren Zhong was made Central Army Commander; Secure-the-Left General Lu Guangda was made Pacify South General and Inspector of South Yuzhou; Minister of Rites Jiang Zong was made Minister of Personnel.
s0082.idiomatic: Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang, general who campaigns south, Jiangzhou inspector, and newly opener equal to the three dukes, was made grand general of the central guard; Shujian, Prince of Changsha, general of agile cavalry, opener equal to the three dukes, and Yangzhou inspector, was made Jiangzhou inspector; Sima Xiaonan, general who campaigns east, opener equal to the three dukes, and East Yangzhou inspector, was promoted to general of chariots and cavalry; Shuwu, Prince of Jinxi, manifest grace general and Danyang administrator, was made Yangzhou inspector; Ren Zhong, general who garrisons south and South Yuzhou inspector, was made central army commander; Lu Guangda, secure-the-left general, was made pacify south general and South Yuzhou inspector; Jiang Zong, minister of rites, was made minister of personnel.

s0083.literal: On guimao day the prince Shen was established as Prince of Shian.
s0083.idiomatic: On guimao day Prince Shen was made Prince of Shian.

s0084.literal: In the second month, dingchou day, the Prince of Shixing Shuzhong was made Inspector of Yangzhou.
s0084.idiomatic: In the second month on dingchou day Shuzhong, Prince of Shixing, was made Yangzhou inspector.

s0085.literal: In the fourth month of summer, wuchen day, the Inspector of Jiaozhou Li Yourong presented tame elephants.
s0085.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on wuchen day Li Yourong, inspector of Jiaozhou, presented tame elephants.

s0086.literal: On jichou day the former Light Chariots General and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Jinxi Shuwu, was made Inspector of Jiangzhou.
s0086.idiomatic: On jichou day Shuwu, Prince of Jinxi, former light chariots general and Yangzhou inspector, was made Jiangzhou inspector.

s0087.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, dingmao day, the General of Agile Cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Changsha Shujian, was made Minister of Works.
s0087.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn on dingmao day Shujian, Prince of Changsha, general of agile cavalry and opener equal to the three dukes, was made minister of works.

s0088.literal: In the ninth month, dingsi day, heaven in the southeast had a sound like insects flying.
s0088.idiomatic: In the ninth month on dingsi day heaven in the southeast sounded like insects flying.

s0089.literal: In the tenth month of winter, dingyou day, the imperial younger brother Shuping was established as Prince of Xiangdong; Shua as Prince of Linhe; Shuxuan as Prince of Yangshan; Shumu as Prince of Xiyang.
s0089.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter on dingyou day the imperial brother Shuping was made Prince of Xiangdong; Shua Prince of Linhe; Shuxuan Prince of Yangshan; Shumu Prince of Xiyang.

s0090.literal: On wuxu day the palace attendant, Secure-the-Right General, Left Grand Master of the Glory, and Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Xu Ling died.
s0090.idiomatic: On wuxu day Xu Ling, palace attendant, secure-the-right general, left grand master of the glory, and junior tutor of the heir apparent, died.

s0091.literal: On guichou day the imperial younger brother Shujian was established as Prince of Nan'an; Shucheng as Prince of Nan commandery; Shuxing as Prince of Yuanling; Shaos as Prince of Yueshan; Shuchun as Prince of Xinxing.
s0091.idiomatic: On guichou day the imperial brother Shujian was made Prince of Nan'an; Shucheng Prince of Nan; Shuxing Prince of Yuanling; Shaos Prince of Yueshan; Shuchun Prince of Xinxing.

s0092.literal: In the twelfth month, gengchen day, the state of Touhe sent envoys presenting local products.
s0092.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengchen day Touhe sent envoys with tribute.

s0093.literal: Minister of Works Prince of Changsha Shujian, guilty, was dismissed.
s0093.idiomatic: Shujian, Prince of Changsha, minister of works, was dismissed for crime.

s0094.literal: On the night of wuwu day heaven opened from the northwest to the southeast; within it were blue and yellow colors, rumbling like thunder.
s0094.idiomatic: On the night of wuwu heaven opened from northwest to southeast; within were blue and yellow, rumbling like thunder.

s0095.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, dingmao day, great envoys were separately sent to tour and inspect local customs.
s0095.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of year 2 on dingmao day great envoys were sent to tour and inspect local customs.

s0096.literal: Pacify South General and Inspector of Yuzhou Lu Guangda was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies South.
s0096.idiomatic: Lu Guangda, pacify south general and Yuzhou inspector, was promoted to general who pacifies south.

s0097.literal: Editorial footnote marker 10. On guisi day a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0097.idiomatic: [10] On guisi day a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0098.literal: In the fifth month of summer, wuzi day, the Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Yongyang Bozhi, was made Pacify East General and Inspector of East Yangzhou; the Light Chariots General and Inspector of Jiangzhou, Prince of Jinxi Shuwu, was made Trustworthy Might General and Inspector of Xiangzhou; the Benevolent Might General and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Shixing Shuzhong, was made Inspector of Jiangzhou; the Trustworthy Martial General and Administrator of Nan Langye and Pengcheng, Prince of Nanping Yan, was made Inspector of Yangzhou; Minister of Personnel Jiang Zong was made Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing.
s0098.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer on wuzi day Bozhi, Prince of Yongyang, vice minister, was made pacify east general and East Yangzhou inspector; Shuwu, Prince of Jinxi, light chariots general and Jiangzhou inspector, was made trustworthy might general and Xiangzhou inspector; Shuzhong, Prince of Shixing, benevolent might general and Yangzhou inspector, was made Jiangzhou inspector; Yan, Prince of Nanping, trustworthy martial general and administrator of Nan Langye and Pengcheng, was made Yangzhou inspector; Jiang Zong, minister of personnel, was made vice minister.

s0099.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, wuchen day, Prince of Changsha Shujian was made palace attendant and Garrison-the-Left General.
s0099.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn on wuchen day Shujian, Prince of Changsha, was made palace attendant and garrison-the-left general.

s0100.literal: On renyang day the crown prince received capping; civil and military in office were each bestowed silk according to rank; filial sons, dutiful brothers, and strong farmers who are heirs to their fathers were each granted one step; widowers, widows, the aged and infirm who cannot support themselves were given five hu of grain per person.
s0100.idiomatic: On renyang day the crown prince received capping; civil and military in post received silk by rank; the filial, dutiful, strong farmers, and heirs each one step; widowers, widows, and the aged who cannot support themselves received five hu of grain each.
